title: Loan-transaction reversal ADDS one counter-leg per original leg (L46 accrual: JE 134 CREDIT OHLGR-10012 11.56, JE 135 DEBIT OHLGR-40010 11.56) with the OPPOSITE side, same transaction date 2026-09-02 and originals JE 84/86 unchanged and unflagged
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal-entry side of the FIRST observed loan-transaction reversal, on the running Fineract server under tenant gerege (loan 11, product 3 OHGLR-Accrual-Loan, ACCRUAL PERIODIC). The loan-11 write-off at business date 2026-09-03 reversed the 2026-09-02 interest accrual transaction L46 as a side effect. request.reversal.journal_entries transcribes the two L46 legs read back BEFORE the reversal: out/loan-11-before-journalentries-raw.json JE 84 DEBIT OHLGR-Interest-Receivable (OHLGR-10012) 11.56 and JE 86 CREDIT OHLGR-Interest-On-Loans (OHLGR-40010) 11.56, both transactionId L46 and transactionDate 2026-09-02, both reversed false; amounts are raised to integer minor units (11.56 -> 1156) with no residue. request.reversal.transaction_date is the reversed transaction's own date 2026-09-02, NOT the write-off business date 2026-09-03. expect.reversal_legs is the FULL after-read-back leg list for L46, transcribed from out/loan-11-after-journalentries-raw.json: the two originals JE 84/86 byte-identical and in order, then the two counter-legs the reversal ADDED, JE 134 CREDIT OHLGR-10012 11.56 and JE 135 DEBIT OHLGR-40010 11.56, both transactionId L46 and transactionDate 2026-09-02 and reversed false. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a loan-transaction reversal ADDS exactly one counter-leg per original leg — same transaction id, same account, same amount, same transaction date, OPPOSITE side — and changes no original. The rule is Fineract createJournalEntryForReversedLoanTransaction (pinned commit 426a23544, lines 359-378), reached from AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan when loanTransactionDTO.isReversed(); it does not modify, flag or delete any original. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the write-off's own five-leg L54 posting (JE 136-140), which is a separate observation (see LN-L11-writeoff-four-bucket-discharge). The manual reversal path revertJournalEntry (lines 380-429) is DIFFERENT and NOT ported here — it posts counter-entries on a FRESH transaction id AND flags each original reversed = true; the two drives that borrow those semantics are exactly why this vector grades each original's reversed flag and each counter-leg's transaction id. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every leg cell is read directly from the committed files.

provenance.note: request.reversal.journal_entries is transcribed from the two pageItems of the committed BEFORE-state read-back out/loan-11-before-journalentries-raw.json whose transactionId is L46 (entry ids 84 and 86); expect.reversal_legs is transcribed from the four pageItems of the committed AFTER-state read-back out/loan-11-after-journalentries-raw.json whose transactionId is L46 (entry ids 84, 86, 134, 135), preserving order. Both captures are single-line JSON documents, so each observation is cited at line 1. capture_case_id names the reversed transaction id L46, which appears in both referenced journal-entries captures. The driver verified that all 24 before-entries are byte-identical in the after read-back; this vector carries only the two L46 legs. No value was synthesised: the side, account, amount, transaction date and reversed flag of every leg are read directly from the files.
